tools.name: notion-search
tools.description: Search the Notion workspace. Returns pages/databases with id, title, url.

tools.name: notion-fetch
tools.description: Fetch a page, database, data source or view by URL or ID. Pages come back in Notion-flavored Markdown (<callout>, <tabs><tab>, <database url=… inline="true" data-source-url=…>, <page url=…>). Databases list their data sources (collection://…) with schema and their views (view://…).

tools.name: notion-query-data-sources
tools.description: Query data. data.mode: "view" runs a saved view by view_url (no quota). data.mode "sql" (the DEFAULT when mode is omitted) and "rows" draw from a limited workspace quota.

tools.name: notion-create-pages
tools.description: Create pages. parent: {page_id} | {database_id} | {data_source_id}. pages: [{properties, content, icon}]. Dates as "date:<Prop>:start"/"date:<Prop>:end"; relations as arrays of page ids. Content is Notion-flavored Markdown: blocks such as <callout icon="…" color="…">, <tabs><tab>…</tab></tabs>, <database url=…>, <page url=…> are written as literal tags, children indented with tabs; do not HTML-escape them.

tools.name: notion-update-page
tools.description: Update a page. command: update_properties | update_content (content_updates: [{old_str,new_str}]) | replace_content (new_str) | insert_content (content, position). icon: emoji or "none". Content is Notion-flavored Markdown: blocks such as <callout icon="…" color="…">, <tabs><tab>…</tab></tabs>, <database url=…>, <page url=…> are written as literal tags, children indented with tabs; do not HTML-escape them.

tools.name: notion-create-database
tools.description: Create a database from a SQL DDL CREATE TABLE statement (schema). Returns the new data source id (collection://…).

tools.name: notion-update-data-source
tools.description: Update a data source: statements (ALTER/ADD/RENAME COLUMN DDL), title, is_inline, in_trash.

tools.name: notion-create-view
tools.description: Create a view: database_id (a view tab on the database) or parent_page_id (a linked view appended to the page). type: table|timeline|board|…; configure: DSL (FILTER, SORT BY, GROUP BY, TIMELINE BY, SHOW).

tools.name: notion-update-view
tools.description: Update a view's name or configuration DSL.

tools.name: notion-create-file-upload
tools.description: Create an upload URL for a local file; returns upload_url and suggested_markdown.
